_sources.section: Covered earnings and retirement earnings test (2026 edition)

content.data/rule: 2000–2026 lower/higher annual exempt amounts; $1/$2 and $1/$3 deductions; FRA month exclusion
1951–2024 national average wage index; age-60 wage indexing; later earnings at face value

content.note: Unpublished wage-index values follow the plan's wage growth curve (fallback: inflation), a planning assumption rather than an SSA forecast. Exempt amounts project from the 2024 wage-index anchor and round to $120. The estimated historical record uses equal positive years and zero years, preserving the entered PIA; it is not an SSA record. Payments are modeled annually, with fully withheld months credited and a proportional worker/spousal allocation. The first claim year approximates the grace rule by protecting benefit months after earned streams stop; substantial self-employment services and SSA payment administration are not modeled.

Survivor reduction-factor adjustment: https://www.ssa.gov/OP_Home/cfr20/404/404-0412.htm and https://www.ssa.gov/OP_Home/handbook/handbook.07/handbook-0728.html. For supported PIA survivors, fully withheld entitled months credit the survivor's age reduction at survivor FRA; recomputation reuses the reduced-worker limit. The earnings test continues until retirement FRA, including any intervening months after survivor FRA. Own retirement ARF increases reduce the survivor top-up in the same month, preserving the combined entitlement.
